_note: PLUGINS PLECTRIFY SHIPS, as opposed to ones it offers. Everything in catalogue.json is fetched at the user's request and installed into a folder they own; everything here is inside the installer, lands beside the executable, is never listed by the Packages panel, and goes away when Plectrify is uninstalled. A plugin belongs here only when the app is not honestly usable without it. Today that is exactly one: every TONE3000 tone is a Neural Amp Modeler capture, and browsing a catalogue of captures with nothing to play them in is not a feature. The pins moved out of catalogue.json when it stopped being a package. Both release scripts read this file, download the archive, check the SHA-256 and stage the .vst3 - so the binary is the same one the catalogue used to hand out, built by us from the MIT source (see PROVENANCE next to each archive) and covered by THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Updating means rebuilding with `pnpm --dir packaging build-plugin`, uploading, and pasting the new version/url/sha256 here.
